name: survey-brief
title: Survey results brief
for_each: select id,code from surveys order by code

sections.title: Approved overall scores
sections.sql: select question,question_text,factor,responses,favorable_pct,state from scorecard where survey_id=$1 order by question

name: action-plan
title: Engagement action plan
for_each: select id,code from actions order by code

sections.title: Progress evidence
sections.sql: select note,progress,evidence_ref,created_at from checkins where action_id=$1 order by created_at

name: outcome-note
title: Action outcome review
for_each: select id,code from actions where status='done' order by code

sections.title: Before and after
sections.note: Overall scores are observational. A score change does not establish causation.

sections.title: Completion evidence
sections.sql: select completed_on,completion_ref,review_on from actions where id=$1
